document_contents.quote: In the SCN, a demand of Rs.23,38,002/- was raised upon the Petitioner.

The taxpayer failed to submit the documents in support of meeting the conditions of Section 16(2)(b) and provisio to Sec 16(2) of the GST Act 2017 i.e. document regarding payment of freight charges to the transporter, weigh bridge slips and party-wise payment ledger, bank statement etc.

defects_argued.quote: The validity of the impugned notifications was under consideration before this Court in a batch of petitions with the lead petition being W.P.(C) 16499/2023 titled ‘DJST Traders Pvt. Ltd. vs. Union of India and Ors.’.
In the opinion of this Court, the impugned order has been passed after duly considering the reply of the Petitioner.

outcome.quote: Petition is disposed of in these terms.
